import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_55/test_0.csv"

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_df = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)

# Transformation:
# Target schema: ['V_GENE']
# Source schema: ['J_CALL']
# The target column V_GENE corresponds to the source column J_CALL but without the allele suffix (e.g., '*02').
# So we need to strip off the allele part from J_CALL values.

# Extract V_GENE by splitting on '*' and taking the first part
source0_df['V_GENE'] = source0_df['J_CALL'].str.split('*').str[0]

# Select only the target column
target_df = source0_df[['V_GENE']]

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_55/target_multisource_cot.csv"
target_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
